### Introduction

MAAT (Modular Architecture and Unified Testbed) is a mechanistic model for photosynthesis and plant respiration. The PEcAn package `PEcAn.MAAT` provides integration with the PEcAn workflow system.

### Installation

```r
# Install from r-universe
options(repos = c(
  pecanproject = 'https://pecanproject.r-universe.dev',
  CRAN = 'https://cloud.r-project.org'))
install.packages('PEcAn.MAAT')
```
